summary: No. 9 UCLA (6-0, 6-0 ATS) is a 15.5-point favorite using backup QB Ty Dieffenbach, who has scored 17 in each of the last two games. Most likely to win: Michigan State +15.5 (-112).

extra_legs.note: UCLA has scored 17 in each of its last two games with a backup QB, so 15.5 asks for a bigger offense than it shows.
UCLA allows 16.2 points and runs the ball for 231 yards a game, and Michigan State scores only 21.3.
UCLA is 6-0 ATS, but the offense has stalled at 17 points in each of its last two games.

totals_projection.math: UCLA 35.5 ppg vs MSU D 25.4 -> 30.5, cut to 27 after 17-point games with Dieffenbach; MSU 21.3 vs UCLA D 16.2 -> 18.8, cut to 16 (MSU ypg 310). Sum 43.0, 1.5 under; margin 11 vs 15.5.

research:
1. QBs/personnel: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava is out (surgery likely, per Chesney). Ty Dieffenbach (former third-string, Cal Poly transfer) went 22/33 for 264 yds in the 17-7 win over Wisconsin (Spectrum/ABC7). MSU QB Alessio Milivojevic is 121/185, 1,263 yds, 7 TD, 3 INT; RB Jaziun Patterson 76-327-5 (ESPN).
2. Injuries: ESPN lists none. UCLA's earlier OUT list (S Tao Johnson, WR Mikey Matthews) is from the team notes.
3. Stats (ESPN): UCLA 35.5 ppg, 445.8 ypg (231 rush), allows 16.2 ppg and 97.7 rush yds. MSU 21.3 ppg, 310.7 ypg, allows 25.4 ppg, 342.6 ypg and 140.7 rush yds.
4. Recent form: UCLA beat SDSU 28-10, Purdue 52-38, Maryland 54-3, Oregon 17-15 (7 Oregon turnovers), Wisconsin 17-7. MSU lost to Northwestern 24-21, Illinois 38-37 OT, Wisconsin 31-3, Nebraska 31-13 and ND 27-10; it is 0-4 in the Big Ten.
5. Scheme: Chesney's UCLA is run-first and clock-controlling (Wayne Knight 84-571-11 TD); the defense wins with a four-man rush. MSU's run D allows 140.7 yds, so UCLA should control the ground.
6. Home field: Rose Bowl, 3:30 PM ET on CBS.
7. Weather (ESPN/AccuWeather): 73F, clear, gusts 6 mph. No effect.
8. Market: ESPN/DraftKings UCLA -15.5 (-108)/MSU +15.5 (-112), ML -700/+500, total 44.5 (o-102/u-118). SI/BetMGM had UCLA -14 (-108), ML -625/+475, total 44.5. Dimers UCLA -13.5. The line is higher than the other snapshots, so +15.5 is the best number found.
9. Models/experts: ESPN predictor UCLA 83.6%. Dimers UCLA 82.5%, about 29-16. SI notes UCLA 6-0 ATS and MSU 7-3 ATS in its last 10.
10. History: UCLA won 38-13 at East Lansing last season (Iamaleava 3 TD).
11. Lean: MSU +15.5 is the most likely leg to win; UCLA's offense has not scored more than 17 in two games and MSU's loss margins are mostly under 15 except at Wisconsin. Under 44.5 has a market-agreeing -118 price.
Sources: ESPN summary/pickcenter, Spectrum News/ABC7, Field Level Media, SI/BetMGM, Dimers, team notes (UCLA.md).
